header: Switch on only the modules you need
lead: There are 12 modules. Start with rota planning and add others when you need them.

items.title: Rota planning
items.text: The core module. Every site has it.

items.title: Time recording
items.text: Clock-ins from tablet, phone or terminal.

items.title: Shift marketplace
items.text: Staff offer and take shifts, and managers approve them.

items.title: Budget control
items.text: Wage cost per week against a branch target.

items.title: Qualifications
items.text: Only certified staff can be planned on shifts that need a certificate.

items.title: Payroll export
items.text: 12 formats, plus a generic CSV file.

items.title: Reporting
items.text: Hours, cost and overtime, grouped the way you need.
